2026-10-23-1.title: New in Madar
2026-10-23-1.body: Now the project list shows 3 pictures, then +2 for the rest. Now a photo with a see-through background shows your glow behind it. Upload the photo again to see the glow. Now the calendar on a computer moves one month for each step of the mouse wheel. Now you can archive a chat. A new message brings it back.
